The three content-block images on /pages/copper-peptide-research — templates/page.research-copper-peptide.json, section `key_findings`, blocks f1, f2, f3. Malcolm's brief, 2026-08-25: medical explainer imagery showing how the ingredient works, in the style of eight reference images he supplied.

VERSION 2. A first cut was written from a Google image-search TERM, because the link Malcolm sent returns an error to any fetch and the reference was never seen. He then supplied the images directly and they are a DIFFERENT REGISTER, so v1 was killed six frames in and moved to assets/ai-generated/_superseded/block-cpr-medical-WRONG-STYLE-dark-clinical. Worth recording what the gap was, because guessing a style from a search term produced a confident, coherent, wrong brief:

                 v1, guessed                       references, actual
    ground       deep saturated blue to near black  PALE, HIGH-KEY, luminous white
    light        one hard key, volumetric           soft, diffuse, almost shadowless
    cells        spindle fibroblasts, fine strands  plump GLOSSY PEBBLES in neat rows
    collagen     hair-thin filaments                smooth RIBBON COLUMNS, hourglass waists
    extras       none                               floating bubbles, descending droplets,
                                                    capsules with the active inside

The references are premium-cosmetics explainer CGI — candy-smooth, rounded, luminous, uncluttered — not scientific-journal visualisation. That is the register these briefs now target.

THE COLOUR IS DELIBERATELY NOT THE REFERENCES' COLOUR, and this is the one judgement Malcolm should overrule if he disagrees. Seven of his eight references are pink or rose. On this site blush pink is PDRN's scene colour, and PDRN's ingredient tile went live today as a blush double helix; Clinical blue 014EB1 is Copper Peptide's, and is already carrying this page's banner, its collection header, its concern tile and its ingredient tile. Making the copper-peptide explainer pink would both contradict the whole page above it and collide with the ingredient next door. So the briefs keep the references' RENDERING LANGUAGE — high-key pastel, soft light, rounded glossy forms — and change only the hue: pearl-white tissue with a cool powder-blue cast, the active in vivid Clinical blue, and copper as the warm accent the references get from gold. Copper is also literally the metal in GHK-Cu.

PINK IS NEGATED EXPLICITLY, and that matters more than usual: 'skin cross-section CGI' is overwhelmingly pink in training data, so an engine will default to it unless barred. The negative list names pink, rose, salmon, peach and red directly.

ONE IMAGE PER BLOCK, EACH TIED TO WHAT THAT BLOCK CLAIMS. The copy is cited and hedged and the picture must not out-claim it:
  f1  'Supports the skin's own collagen & renewal pathways' (Pickart & Margolina 2018) -> the fibrous scaffold, with the active present among it. Mechanism.
  f2  'Supports skin-renewal cell activity (independent lab study)' (Kang 2009, cultured keratinocytes and skin-equivalent models) -> LAB TISSUE, isolated, not a person. The study is in-vitro; a face would convert a lab result into a human one.
  f3  'Greater satisfaction with skin appearance' (Miller 2006, RCT, 12 weeks) -> the trial measured SELF-REPORTED SATISFACTION, not a measured change. No before/after, no split frame, no smoothing comparison: each would assert an efficacy result the study did not produce.

THE DOUBLE HELIX STAYS BARRED, even though one reference shows helices descending into the skin. PDRN is polydeoxyribonucleotide and its tile IS a helix as of today; if copper peptide also gets one the two ingredients stop being distinguishable at a glance. Copper peptide's territory is the fibrous scaffold and the copper ion.

Square 2048x2048 — all three blocks render 1:1 at sizes 'min(720px, 50vw)', measured off the live DOM. CLASS B, no references attached, FLUX.2 in the run.

slots.title: f1 · the fibrous scaffold, with the active among it
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium cosmetics advertising: smooth candy-like CGI, every form rounded and glossy, rendered high-key on a pale luminous background. Square format.

The scene looks along a shallow space between two beds of soft rounded shapes — an even bed of plump, smooth, translucent pebble-like forms below, and the underside of a similar bed above. Standing between them, filling the middle of the frame, are five or six tall smooth columns: each is a bundle of glossy ribbons that gathers inward at its waist into a slender hourglass and flares out again where it meets the beds above and below, like polished pillars holding the two apart. They are pearl white with a cool powder-blue sheen, catching soft rim highlights down their length.

Clear glassy bubbles of several sizes float in the space between the columns, perfectly smooth and transparent, some catching a bright pinpoint highlight. Descending among them are several translucent droplets of clear vivid blue, colour hex 014EB1, the only saturated colour in the frame; two of them are round capsules holding a small cluster of polished copper spheres, colour hex B87333, suspended inside.

Soft diffuse light from above with gentle rim highlights and almost no hard shadow. Shallow depth of field, the far columns dissolving into a pale blue-white haze. Clean, minimal and uncluttered — a few large clear forms rather than a busy field of detail. Glossy, luminous, immaculate.

slots.title: f2 · laboratory-grown skin tissue, renewal activity in the lowest row
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium cosmetics advertising: smooth candy-like CGI, every form rounded and glossy, rendered high-key on a pale luminous background. Square format.

A cross-section through a small piece of laboratory-grown tissue, seen from the side and filling the frame. It is built of many stacked horizontal rows of plump, smooth, translucent pebble-like cells, each one glossy and softly glowing from within, packed neatly against its neighbours. The upper rows are broader and flatter; the lowest row is noticeably rounder, plumper and brighter than everything above it, and two of those lowest cells are pinched into a figure-of-eight in the act of becoming two.

The whole piece sits isolated on a smooth translucent surface with clean empty space around it, unmistakably a specimen grown in a dish rather than part of a body. Everything is pearl white with a cool powder-blue cast. A few clear glassy bubbles rest between the rows, and three or four translucent capsules of clear vivid blue, colour hex 014EB1, sit among the lower cells, each holding a small cluster of polished copper spheres, colour hex B87333 — the only saturated colour in the frame, and brightest where the lowest cells are.

Soft diffuse light from above, gentle rim highlights, almost no hard shadow. Shallow depth of field, the edges of the specimen dissolving into a pale blue-white haze. Clean, minimal and uncluttered. Glossy, luminous, immaculate.

slots.title: f3 · the surface, even and refined, with the active arriving
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium cosmetics advertising: smooth candy-like CGI, every form rounded and glossy, rendered high-key on a pale luminous background. Square format.

Seen from the side, a smooth continuous surface layer sweeps across the frame in one gentle undulating wave, glossy and slightly translucent like poured glaze, its crest catching a long soft highlight. Directly beneath it, supporting it, lies a tightly packed bed of plump rounded translucent spheres in even rows, each glowing softly from within and pressing up against the layer above. Everything is pearl white with a cool powder-blue cast, and the surface is smooth, even and refined along its whole length, with no cracks, flaking or roughness.

From the upper part of the frame, a scattered fall of translucent droplets of clear vivid blue, colour hex 014EB1, descends towards the surface in loose vertical trails — some still falling and elongated into teardrops, one or two already resting on the crest and beading there. A single droplet is a clear capsule holding a small cluster of polished copper spheres, colour hex B87333. The blue is the only saturated colour in the frame.

The upper third of the frame is soft empty pale gradient, luminous and clean. Soft diffuse light, gentle rim highlights, almost no hard shadow. Shallow depth of field. Clean, minimal and uncluttered. Glossy, luminous, immaculate.
